title: Senior Human Resources Business Partner
description:
**kAIgentic** is building the intelligence layer for the world's most ambitious enterprises. Headquartered in Singapore with teams in India and Japan, our software platform helps large organizations evolve as fast as technology itself by turning the tacit know\-how locked inside their people into safe, governed, AI\-powered operations.


The hardest part of enterprise transformation is not strategy. It is execution. Institutional knowledge lives in people's heads, systems are fragmented, and risk tolerance is low. kAIgentic captures how work actually happens, designs better workflows, and runs them inside an intelligence layer that is observable, auditable, and engineered for the most regulated environments on earth. The outcome is an enterprise that continuously improves.


We are backed by SMBC Group as our founding partner and customer zero, and our platform is already being proven inside one of the most complex, regulated operating environments in the world. That means real problems, real data, and real production impact from Day 1\.

### **The Role**


As a Senior HR Business Partner, you will work directly with the CHRO, the Head of Talent Acquisition, and the core leadership team to build the people foundation that lets kAIgentic’s intelligence layer scale. You will solve the hardest problems in building a high\-performance, AI\-native culture, designing people systems that use AI natively, and standing up the early\-career talent engine that powers our next phase of growth.


This is a role for a hands\-on, systems\-thinking HR professional who wants to do more than run processes. You will translate our values of customer obsession, courage, care, and curiosity into how the company actually operates, and you will partner with our tech team to shape AI\-first people systems where the work is real and directly tied to how kAIgentic grows.

### **What You’ll Do**

* Build and scale a high\-performance, AI\-native culture rooted in our values of customer obsession, courage, care, and curiosity, and launch programs that bring those values to life every day.
* Translate mission and principles into daily operating norms: decision rights, feedback mechanisms, and leadership behaviors that match our growth phase.
* Partner with Product and Engineering to design and embed AI\-native HR workflows, including performance review, listening mechanisms, AI\-assisted policy Q\&A, and people analytics summaries, into how HR operates.
* Design lightweight performance and feedback rhythms suited to a high\-bar, low\-politics, early\-stage environment.
* Lay the analytics foundation. Implement HRIS, build simple dashboards, and ensure clean, reliable people data.
* Partner with Talent Acquisition to sharpen our employer brand and Employee Value Proposition, build a champion community of employees who tell our story externally, and collaborate on content and social campaigns.
* Build the end\-to\-end early\-career talent engine: target institutions, role design, internships, fellowships, live projects, and case challenges, with structured 0\-to\-1 learning paths so freshers contribute to real work from week one.
* Own the lifecycle moments that shape employee experience: onboarding, manager connects, performance reviews, career conversations, and exits.
* Drive the annual performance review cycle for India leaders across Engineering, Product, and Customer Success.
* Build engagement mechanisms such as pulse checks, team connects, and recognition forums, and translate employee signal into practical actions with managers and leaders.
* Partner with managers to spot early signs of friction, disengagement, or manager\-effectiveness gaps, and resolve them with speed and maturity.
* Manage grievances with fairness, confidentiality, and judgment. Stand up the Grievance Committee and POSH foundation.
* Work with external partners (search firms, legal, payroll / PEO, advisors) to continuously improve the experience of core HR operations.

### **What You’ll Bring**

* 7\+ years of experience in HR, with a strong mix of Talent Acquisition and HR business partnering or people operations.
* AI\-native velocity as a default mode of working (mandatory). Curious about how AI\-native workflows can make HR sharper, faster, and fairer, and willing to learn by doing.
* Proven experience partnering with Product and Engineering leaders and driving engagement of senior tech talent in product / SaaS, fintech, consulting, or high\-growth tech startups where the bar for talent and pace is high.
* Hands\-on experience setting up or significantly improving HR processes, policies, and tools in a lean environment.
* High ownership bias. You see gaps, propose solutions, and run them to the ground.
* Comfort working directly with founders and senior leaders, including pushing back thoughtfully using data and judgment.
* Energized by complex domains even when you are not yet an expert, with a track record of learning quickly.
* Sound judgment, discretion, and fairness in handling sensitive employee matters.

**Why join kAIgentic?**


We are a global team of builders who thrive in ambiguity, care deeply about the customers we serve, and believe the intelligence layer is how enterprise work will be reshaped over the next decade. We are building the connective tissue that lets large companies operate with the speed of a startup and the trust of an institution.


We look for people who:

* Combine technical excellence with genuine customer empathy.
* Are entrepreneurial and energized by zero\-to\-one problems with no playbook.
* Lead with ownership, integrity, and collaboration, not titles.
* Want to help define a new category of enterprise AI, not just ship inside an existing one.
* Working here means being surrounded by peers who challenge assumptions, celebrate progress, and build with both courage and care.

**Life at kAIgentic**

* Intelligence layer at the core. You will be shaping the substrate that turns institutional knowledge into governed, production\-grade operations. This is enterprise infrastructure with real consequences.
* Innovation at enterprise scale. Startup velocity meets the depth, scale, and stakes of mission\-critical, regulated environments. Both are non\-negotiable.
* Ownership from Day One. Your work directly shapes the product, the culture, and the outcomes our customers see.
* Learning and growth. You will work alongside seasoned leaders from leading enterprises who have built and scaled global businesses.
* A culture of trust. Psychological safety, transparent disagreement, and disciplined experimentation are how we operate, not slogans on a wall.
* Global collaboration. Teams across Singapore, India, Japan, Europe, and the US, working as one.
* A mission worth the effort. Building something the world has not seen before: anintelligence layer that helps enterprises continuously improve how they run.

AI Garage is a new initiative within People Operations (POps) and Corp Engineering, established with the goal of leveraging AI to transform Google’s HR products and operations. We bring the world's most innovative people to Google and provide the programs that help them thrive. * Organizational skills
* Basic knowledge of double entry bookkeeping
* Good excel skills
* Excellent attention to detail

* Strong communication skills

* Basic knowledge of Benefits legislation and practices

title: HR Tech Data Engineer
description:
**Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.**
We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.

We use cutting\-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience. **Want to be part of it?** **Purpose of the Role :**  



This is a rare and distinctive role at the intersection of People, Technology, and AI.



You will own Keyloop’s People Technology ecosystem and HR data infrastructure, including rebuilding a Python\-based analytics platform connected to our data lake and core HR systems. This platform will deliver secure, SSO\-enabled insights and power reporting across People Analytics, Talent Acquisition, L\&D, and Engagement. You will also lead integrations with systems such as SAP SuccessFactors.



Alongside this, you will act as an internal expert in agentic AI. You will enable teams to confidently use AI and data, combining hands\-on building with strong teaching and influencing.



Operating with high autonomy, you will partner with senior leadership to shape both **w**hat we build and how AI is adopted globally.



### **Role \& Resonsibilities**


* Own and evolve Keyloop’s People Data Platform and HR analytics dashboard (Python/Streamlit), delivering insights via SSO
* Design and maintain data architecture (pipelines, schemas, models) across SAP SuccessFactors and other HR systems
* Manage API integrations and data access with core platforms and third\-party vendors
* Deliver insights across People Metrics, TA, L\&D, and Engagement, partnering with functional leads
* Own BAU reporting, driving accuracy, automation, and self\-service adoption
* Ensure GDPR and data compliance, including access controls and auditability
* Build and scale AI\-driven HR solutions (LLMs, agentic workflows, document processing, large\-scale pipelines)
* Develop production\-ready AI use cases (e.g., attrition insights, skills inference, policy Q\&A, candidate processing) and evaluate emerging tools
* .Act as HR AI SME, enabling adoption through training, playbooks, and self\-service frameworks across HR and G\&A
* .Partner with senior leadership, IT (AWS), and governance forums to shape the People Technology roadmap and responsible AI practices
### **Skills \& Experience**

### **Essential**


* Strong Python expertise building production\-grade data applications, dashboards, or tools.
* Hands\-on experience in data engineering (ETL pipelines, API integrations, data modelling).
* Proven track record integrating LLM/AI APIs (e.g., Anthropic, OpenAI) into live applications.
* Solid knowledge of AWS and modern data/visualisation frameworks (e.g., Streamlit, Plotly).
* Experience with SSO/authentication (OAuth2, SAML, Azure AD / Entra ID).
* Strong data literacy and storytelling, with the ability to communicate insights to non\-technical audiences.
* High autonomy with a rigorous approach to data privacy, security, and compliance.

### **Desirable**


* Experience with SAP SuccessFactors or similar HRIS, including API/OData integration.
* Proficiency in Power BI (data modelling, DAX, dashboards).
* Familiarity with agentic AI frameworks (e.g., LangChain, CrewAI).
* Experience designing or delivering learning/upskilling programmes.
* Understanding of HR data domains (e.g., headcount, attrition, hiring, engagement).
* Exposure to Azure ecosystem and/or Terraform.
* Experience working with senior stakeholders, vendors, and global teams.
**Why join us?**
We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space – and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game\-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. Join Keyloop and progress your career, your way.

**An inclusive environment to thrive**
We’re committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity. We promote an inclusive culture within our business, and we celebrate different employees and lifestyles – not just on key days, but every day.

**Be rewarded for your efforts**
We believe people should be paid based on their performance so our pay and benefits reflect this and are designed to attract the very best talent. We encourage everyone in our organisation to explore opportunities which enable them to grow their career through investment in their development but equally by working in a culture which fosters support and unbridled collaboration.

Keyloop doesn’t require academic qualifications for this position. We select based on experience and potential, not credentials.

**We are also an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We value diversity and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply***.*

*"****At Keyloop, AI is a daily ally: We encourage and train every employee to use our AI tools to boost their creativity and productivity.****"*
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

**Job Summary:**

We are seeking a skilled and self\-motivated Embedded Developer Intern with hands\-on knowledge in bare\-metal programming for **microcontrollers and microprocessors.** The ideal candidate will excel at reading datasheets, writing efficient, clean, and custom code without relying on external libraries or AI\-based assistance, and working independently to design and implement robust embedded solutions.

The candidate should demonstrate expertise in low\-level **hardware\-software integration,** serial and wireless communication protocols, and a solid understanding of embedded platforms such as **AVR, STM32,** or similar architectures.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1\. Firmware Development:**

o Develop, test, and debug firmware for embedded systems, primarily for **AVR, STM32, or similar platforms.**

o Implement optimized, lightweight code for bare\-metal applications.

o Integrate hardware peripherals **(GPIO, ADC, UART, SPI, I2C, etc.)** with custom firmware.

**2\. Hardware Interaction:**

o Analyze and interpret datasheets, reference manuals, and schematics to enable seamless hardware\-software integration.

o Collaborate with the hardware team to design and validate **embedded hardware interfaces.**

**3\. Protocol Implementation:**

o Design and implement communication protocols, including UART, I2C, SPI, and CAN.

o Develop wireless communication solutions using LoRa, Bluetooth, ZigBee, or equivalent technologies.

**4\. Testing \& Debugging:**

o Perform hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) testing to validate embedded designs.

o Use debugging tools such as logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, and protocol analyzers.

**5\. Documentation \& Collaboration:**

o Maintain comprehensive documentation of firmware designs, processes, and debugging steps.

o Work closely with cross\-functional teams to ensure project timelines and deliverables are met.

\-\-\-

Required Skills and Qualifications:

**· Technical Proficiency:**

o Strong proficiency in C, C\+\+, and low\-level assembly programming.

o Experience with bare\-metal development and RTOS is highly desirable.

o Familiarity with microcontrollers like AVR, STM32, or SoCs with ARM Cortex cores.

**· Peripheral Knowledge:**

o Deep understanding of hardware peripherals such as ADC, PWM, Timers, and DMA.

o Knowledge of interfacing sensors, displays, and actuators with embedded platforms.

· Communication Protocols:

o Proficient in serial communication protocols **(UART, I2C, SPI, etc.).**

o Experience in wireless protocols like **LoRa, Bluetooth, or ZigBee.**

**· Debugging \& Tools:**

o Hands\-on experience with debugging tools such as **JTAG, SWD, and software like Keil, IAR, or STM32CubeIDE.**

o Proficiency in using lab equipment: logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, and multimeters.

· Soft Skills:

o Strong problem\-solving ability and a proactive approach to debugging and optimization.

· Knowledge of low\-power design principles for **embedded systems.**

* Organized, deadline\-aware, and able to take ownership without constant follow\-ups.

**ABOUT STRING METAVERSE**

String Metaverse Limited (BSE: STRING) is a publicly listed company operating at the intersection of Web3, Artificial Intelligence, and high\-frequency trading. Our Dubai\-headquartered trading desk runs autonomous options strategies on crypto and equity derivatives, with our technology stack spanning Deribit, Tastytrade, Hyperliquid, and Solana\-native DeFi protocols. We are building AI agents that trade, reason, and evolve — and we want traders who think the same way.

**THE ROLE**

You will be a core member of our HFT \& Digital Advisory desk, working directly on live derivatives positions, trade reporting, and strategy research. This is not a back\-office role — you will be expected to understand live positions, propose strategic improvements, and use AI tools to move faster and think more clearly than a traditional analyst ever could.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

– Monitor and manage live options positions — diagonal spreads, theta strategies, and volatility plays on BTC, ETH, and US equities

– Read, interpret, and act on trade reports — P\&L attribution, Greeks exposure, and drawdown analysis

– Research and back\-test options strategies; identify entry and exit signals using data\-driven frameworks

– Build and maintain reports, dashboards, and trade logs using AI tools including Claude, Claude Code, and Cursor

– Collaborate with our AI Agents team to feed market insights into autonomous trading agents

– Support on\-chain and off\-chain trade reconciliation across Deribit, Tastytrade, and Hyperliquid

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

*We evaluate how you think, not what your CV looks like. Inspired by how the world's best trading firms hire, we care about problem\-solving, mathematical intuition, and intellectual curiosity above credentials.*

– **Mathematical intuition —** Fast, accurate reasoning about probability, expected value, and risk — you think in distributions, not just averages

– **Options literacy —** Solid understanding of options payoffs, Greeks (delta, theta, gamma, vega), and how they interact across time and volatility regimes

– **Analytical depth —** Ability to read a trade report, spot anomalies, and frame a clear data\-backed view of what to do next

– **AI fluency —** You actively use Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent AI tools in your daily workflow; bonus if you have used Claude Code, Cursor, or built prompts to automate analytical tasks

– **Communication —** Ability to explain a complex position or risk scenario concisely, in writing or verbally

– **Edge\-case thinking —** You naturally ask "what could go wrong?" before asking "what is the expected return?"

**GOOD TO HAVE**

– Exposure to crypto derivatives (Deribit, Bybit, Hyperliquid) or US equity options (Tastytrade, IBKR)

– Familiarity with Python, Excel modelling, or any scripting for data analysis

– Academic background in Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Computer Science, or Economics

– Understanding of blockchain, DeFi, or on\-chain trading mechanics

– Experience with back\-testing frameworks or systematic strategy research

**OUR HIRING PHILOSOPHY**

We do not enforce GPA cutoffs or require a finance degree. A fresher who thinks sharply, uses AI tools effectively, and reasons well under uncertainty will be preferred over an experienced candidate who works on instinct alone. Compensation is determined entirely by what you demonstrate in the evaluation process — not by years of experience on paper.

 We are a close\-knit tribe, united by a shared love for travel and on a mission to become the most loved hospitality brand in India.
   

  

**Why Work With Us?**
 At StayVista, you're part of a community where your ideas and growth matter. We’re a fast\-growing team that values continuous improvement. With our skill upgrade programs, you’ll keep learning and evolving, just like we do. And hey, when you’re ready for a break, our villa discounts make it easy to enjoy the luxury you help create.
   

  

**Your Role**
 As an
 **Intern at StayVista** 
 , we’ve always believed that the next generation of builders deserves more than just classroom learning, case studies, or theoretical exposure. India’s Future Founders Programme 2\.0 is built for ambitious students and young professionals who aspire to understand what it truly takes to build, scale, market, and operate a fast\-growing consumer brand. Through this programme, you will be responsible for contributing to real business initiatives while gaining first\-hand exposure to high\-impact projects across multiple functions. This is not a conventional internship. It is a high\-ownership, fast\-paced opportunity where you will work closely with teams across business, marketing, growth, partnerships, operations, content, and product — gaining hands\-on experience while driving meaningful business outcomes and strategic initiatives.
   

  

**What You’ll Work On**
 Depending on your strengths and interests, you may work across one or more of the following functions:
   

  

* Brand \& Marketing: Work on campaigns, content strategy, social media, influencer marketing, partnerships, and brand\-building initiatives across StayVista and its sub\-brands.
* Finance: Gain exposure to budgeting, business performance tracking, revenue analysis, financial planning, and understanding how high\-growth consumer businesses operate financially.
* Revenue Management: Learn how pricing, occupancy, demand forecasting, and inventory management drive growth in hospitality and travel businesses.
* Human Resources: Support hiring, culture\-building, internal communication, employee engagement initiatives, and people operations across teams.
* Guest Operations: Understand how guest experience is managed end\-to\-end — from bookings and hospitality operations to service quality and customer satisfaction.
* Data Management: Work with business dashboards, reporting systems, campaign performance analysis, operational insights, and decision\-making driven by data
* Technology: Collaborate on product, automation, website/app improvements, AI\-led initiatives, customer experience flows, operational tech systems, and solving real business problems through technology and innovation.


**Who We’re Looking For**
* Students or young professionals (aged 15\-22\) passionate about startups, marketing, business, or entrepreneurship
* Strong communicators and self\-starters
* People who take initiative and enjoy solving problems
* Curious minds who like building things from scratch
* Individuals comfortable working in fast\-moving environments
* Prior startup, content, marketing, or leadership experience is a bonus — but not mandatory.


**What You’ll Gain**
* Direct exposure to startup building
* Real business ownership from day one
* Mentorship from experienced operators and founders
* Hands\-on experience across multiple functions
* A chance to work on projects with visible impact
* Access to one of India’s fastest\-growing hospitality brands


**Our Core Values:** 
 Are you a
 ***CURATER?***
* Curious: Here, your curiosity fuels innovation.
* User\-Centric: You’ll anticipate the needs of all our stakeholders and exceed expectations.
* Resourceful: You’ll creatively optimise our resources with solutions that elevate experiences in unexpected ways.
* Aspire: Keep learning, keep growing—because we’re all about continuous improvement.
* Trust: Trust is our foundation. You’ll work in a transparent, reliable, and fair environment.
* Enjoy: We believe in having fun while building something extraordinary.


**StayVista Spirit: Our Behavioral Competencies – How We Work Together**
* Business Acumen: You grasp the basics of our organization, customers, and services, always thinking ahead in your work. You’re mindful of costs and benefits, making smart decisions while learning from risks and mistakes.
* Change Management: You’re open to change, adjusting quickly to new information or challenges. Always eager to learn, you find creative ways to improve your work and seek feedback for growth.
* Leadership: You set clear goals, guide your team with energy, and take full responsibility for the work, ensuring others respect your leadership through action.
* Customer Centricity: You understand both internal and external customer needs and take ownership in addressing any service issues. You maintain clear communication and handle customer interactions with patience and respect.
* Teamwork: You collaborate well with others, respecting diverse opinions and always contributing positively to the team. You keep lines of communication open and share your thoughts without judgment.
* Result Orientation: You take responsibility for completing tasks and proactively tackle challenges to exceed expectations. You’re quick to spot issues and address them efficiently, making decisive decisions with resourcefulness.
* Planning and Organizing: You handle multiple priorities well, staying organized and focused. You ensure your work is thorough, accurate, and aligned with set processes to meet goals effectively.
* Communication: You communicate your ideas clearly, encourage dialogue, and ensure timely responses to your team, clients, and manager. You assert your views confidently and use multiple channels to share information effectively.


 StayVista is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decisions based on race, colour, religion, caste, creed, nationality, age, sex, including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected under applicable laws.

Be part of an inclusive, collaborative culture that rewards you for your contributions, and work with other talented individuals who share your passion for doing great work. You’ll also have plenty of opportunities to make your mark at the office and a difference in your community. So, if you're talented, driven and want to work for a strong, ethical company that cares, take the next step and create a career at Ameriprise India LLP.

**Job Description**


Lead Payroll Analyst plays a critical role within our Global Payroll services team to ensure timely and accurate payroll for our international employees by ensuring data changes are compliant and tax accounts balance.**Key Responsibilities**

* Review and approve payroll changes and submit to payroll partner/systems across multiple countries. Ensure these are compliant with country specific regulations before submission.

* Conduct monthly analysis of payroll data for final approval, identify and resolve any issues arising.

* Prepare payments for approvals

* Collaborate with stakeholders to ensure controls are maintained.
* Communicate with business on legislative changes that will impact their area
* Complete end of year analysis and prepare for final approval for each country.
* Ad hoc reporting
* Prepare and track payroll invoices for approval
* Assist in Global mobility and Employment tax tasks in relation to payroll \& benefits.
* Assist International Payroll Manager with audits and risk assessments.

* Previous EMEA/APAC payroll experience for at least 5 years
* Organizational skills
* Basic knowledge of double entry bookkeeping
* Good excel skills
* Excellent attention to detail
* Good customer service skills
* Strong communication skills

 **Preferred Qualifications**

* Basic knowledge of HR Policies and practices
* Basic knowledge of Benefits legislation and practices

 At Louis Vuitton, we believe that our people are the true ambassadors of our Maison. As a Human Resources Business Partner, you will play a pivotal role in shaping a high\-performance culture by partnering closely with leaders and teams to drive strategic people initiatives.
   

  

 You will act as a trusted advisor, championing talent development, fostering engagement, and ensuring the seamless deployment of HR practices aligned with the values and ambitions of the Maison.

**Employee Engagement \& Culture**
* Champion employee engagement initiatives that reinforce a culture of excellence and belonging
* Anchor LVMH Group initiatives locally, ensuring strong alignment with Maison priorities

**HR Operations \& Analytics**

 Profile
   

  

* Education: Degree holder in Human Resources Management or equivalent

title: Senior Manager - Human Resources (C&B)
description:
We are seeking an experienced Compensation \& Benefits (C\&B) professional to lead and manage the full spectrum of rewards, benefits, payroll governance, and statutory compliance for our India operations. This role is responsible for designing competitive compensation structures, driving Total Rewards strategy, managing compliance with Labour Codes, and ensuring a consistent, fair, and scalable rewards framework that supports talent attraction, retention, and organisational growth.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Compensation \& Benefits**
* Lead the C\&B portfolio for India across plants, sales, and corporate functions.
* Drive Total Rewards Strategy, job mapping, job grading, salary structure design, and benchmarking exercises.
* Manage annual merit planning, variable pay cycles, budgeting, salary fitments, and compensation analytics.
* Design and administer employee benefits, insurance programs, wellness initiatives, and Reward \& Recognition.
* Ensure accuracy and governance across compensation policies, offer guidelines, and performance‑linked outcomes.
* Partner with HRBP and Talent Acquisition to support manpower planning and competitive hiring decisions.


**Manpower Planning**
* Drive manpower cost efficiency through workforce utilisation insights, headcount planning, and FTE governance.


**Statutory Compliance**
* Act as the SPOC for all statutory HR compliances across locations.
* Lead the implementation of all Labour Codes – Wage Code, Social Security Code, OSH Code, and IR Code.
* Align compensation structures with statutory definitions of wages, PF/ESIC guidelines, bonus rules, gratuity norms, and working‑condition requirements.
* Govern multi‑state compliance, HRMS statutory configuration, SOP creation, and internal/external audits.
* Drive communication, training, and change management for Labour Code.


**Payroll Governance**
* Oversee payroll accuracy, statutory deductions, audit readiness, MIS reporting, F\&F settlements, and compliance documentation.


**HRIS \& Vendor Management**
* Manage key C\&B and HR vendors including payroll, insurance, tax consultants, actuarial partners, and HRIS project stakeholders.


**Expatriate Management**
* Manage incoming and outgoing expatriate processes including visas, tax working, relocation, gross‑up calculations, and coordination with external partners.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* MBA/PGDM in HR
* 8–12 years of experience in C\&B, payroll governance, HR compliance, and rewards management preferable in FMCG, Pharma, Life Sciences, or Manufacturing industry
* Additional certifications in Rewards, Compensation Management, HR Analytics, or Labour Law are an advantage
* Strong working knowledge of Indian Labour Codes, statutory frameworks, job evaluation, salary structures, and HR analytics.
* Proven ability to partner with senior leadership, manage vendors, and drive data‑based decision‑making.
* Experience managing HR vendors, HRIS tools, and multi‑location compliance

**Dotted Line Reporting: General Manager, Operations – India \& South Asia**




  

  





**Role Overview:**




 The People Director will be a strategic and operational leader responsible for shaping and executing the organization’s people strategy. This role partners closely with senior leadership to enable business growth, build strong organizational capability, ensure compliance, and foster a high\-performance, inclusive culture.

title: Director of Human Resources | Conrad Bengaluru
description:
With thousands of hotels in over 100 countries and territories, Hilton offers countless opportunities to delight. From an open door to a welcoming smile and an exceptional experience, we offer the millions of travellers who stay with us every year a welcome they will never forget. In addition to our flagship brand, Hilton Hotels \& Resorts, the family of brands includes Waldorf Astoria, LXR, Conrad, Canopy, Curio Collection, DoubleTree, Hilton Garden Inn, Hampton and many others.
   

  

 If you appreciate the impact global travel can have on the world, you may be just the person we are looking for to work as a Hilton Team Member. Because it’s with Hilton where we never forget the reason we're here: to delight our guests, Team Members, and owners alike.
   

  

 The Director of Human Resources operates the Human Resources functions in accordance to government policies, Hilton brand requirements and hotel related policies. This role works closely with the hotel General Managers and the Executive team to work out human capital strategy plans, build up effective performance evaluation systems, recognition programs and talent development methods to form a high performance team to achieve hotel business targets and improve employer brand.
   

  

**What will I be doing?**
 As the Director of Human Resources, you will be responsible for performing the following tasks to the highest standards:
   

  

* Establish HR strategy plans and lead the HR team to achieve HR objectives based on the hotel’s annual strategy plan.
* Adjust and improve the human capital plan and HR operations to support business requirements.
* Ensure that the department’s activities are aligned with the corporate HR strategy, and that the hotel‘s actions have been implemented where appropriate.
* Establish, maintain and ensure adherence to all personnel\-related policies and procedures.
* Work with the Executive team to establish and review hotel rules and regulations, being responsible for the related trainings, communication and execution.
* Support the financial objectives of the hotel through proper and efficient management.

* Fully in charge of all HR functions’ and departments’ daily operations and team management.
* Responsible for HR team member trainings and development, ensure that they work under the guidance of proper procedures.
* Create an open\-door environment in the hotel to drive effective communication.
* Ensure that HR personnel provide the appropriate level of professionalism, courtesy and care to other team members (internal guests) and other visitors to the division.
* Assist and coach department heads to improve leadership skills in the department’s team management.
* Ensure that team members follow all hotel, company and local rules, policies and regulations.
* Assist the department to manage team members, maintain a high standard of personal appearance and hygiene, adhering to hotel and department grooming standards.
* Represent the hotel in union negotiations and related activities, working closely with the regional HR team and the hotel Management team accordingly.
* Able to understand the market situation and take effective actions to make adjustments.
* Assist the General Manager to maintain a good relationship with the hotel owner.
* Oversee the hotel's recruitment and selection process, providing department managers with effective and efficient recruitment solutions.
* Look for creative cooperation methods with different talent service channels to improve recruitment effectiveness and enhance hotel brand image.
* Work with the Operations department to maximize labor work efficiency, and control labor costs.
* Participate in outsourced labor contract signing procedures, assist the Operations department to monitor service quality and payment.
* Propose and implement the competitive compensation and benefits structure.
* Guide Learning \& Development Managers to enhance training systems in the hotel, assisting to develop training skills of qualified department trainers and the managers.
* Periodically conduct talent reviews with managers and implement succession programs and high potential development plans.
* Guide and coach department managers to manage the team well, improving team performance and moral.
* Cultivate hotel and brand culture, unifying team member behaviors, procedures and policies, influencing the team with positive feedback.
* Ensure that the hotel is adheres to all company / hotel HR policies and procedures, including hygiene, safe and security policies.
* Ensure that team member facilities are maintained according to Hilton’s high standards of operation.
* Maintain safety and cleanliness of work areas and team member areas, including but not limited to the team member kitchen and locker rooms.
* Supervise the Team Member Canteen Chef to operate the canteen kitchen, meeting related standards, good cost control, and serving a variety of high\-quality food to team members.
* Manage the team member dormitory and create safe and secure living conditions for team members, implementing the dormitory check system and entertainment activities to encourage the THRIVE life for team members.
* Carry out any other reasonable duties and responsibilities as assigned.
* The Management reserves the right to make changes to this job description at its sole discretion and without advance notice.

 A Director of Human Resources serving Hilton Brands is always working on behalf of our Guests and working with other Team Members. To successfully fill this role, you should maintain the attitude, behaviours, skills, and values that follow:

* Minimum 2 year of experience in a similar position with an international brand hotel.
* Strategic thinking and good analysis and planning skills.
* Open minded and a team player.
* Good communication skills.

 A Director of Human Resources serving Hilton Brands is always working on behalf of our Guests and working with other Team Members. To successfully fill this role, you should maintain the attitude, behaviours, skills, and values that follow:

title: Robotics Engineer
description:
As a Robotics Software Engineer, you will take end\-to\-end ownership of robot software and control systems from trajectory planning and motion control to real hardware deployment. You will work at the intersection of ROS\-based software, real\-time simulation, and physical robot systems in a fast\-paced startup environment where you ship working solutions and iterate quickly.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, and maintain ROS/ROS 2\-based software stacks for robotic manipulators and mobile platforms used in precision aerospace lab environments.
* Implement and validate trajectory planning and motion control algorithms for multi\-DOF robotic arms and autonomous systems.
* Develop real\-time kinematics and dynamics simulations using Gazebo, MuJoCo, Isaac Sim, PyBullet, RViz, and MATLAB/Simulink to model robot behavior in representative environments.
* Implement forward and inverse kinematics/dynamics and integrate them into end\-to\-end control pipelines.
* Tune controllers and optimize system performance for reliability and precision in mission\-critical contexts.
* Integrate sensor suites (IMUs, cameras, LiDAR, encoders) with robot middleware, and develop calibration and sensor fusion pipelines.
* Debug issues across the full stack from planning algorithms down to hardware interfaces.
* Collaborate closely with systems and hardware engineers to define software interfaces, communication protocols, and control loop requirements.
* Write clean, well\-documented C\+\+ and Python code with a focus on safety\-critical embedded software practices.
* Support hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) testing and rapid prototyping and contribute to verification and validation of robotic subsystems.


**Requirements**
* Robotics Middleware: ROS / ROS 2 MoveIt / MoveIt 2 Nav2 roslaunch, actionlib.
* Programming: C\+\+ (proficient), Python (proficient), CMake, Git.
* Motion and Control: Trajectory planning, Inverse and forward kinematics, PID and model\-based control.
* Simulation Tools: Gazebo, MuJoCo, PyBullet, RViz, MATLAB / Simulink, Isaac Sim.
* Math and Algorithms: Linear algebra, Quaternion math, Rigid body dynamics, Numerical methods.
* Sensing and Perception: IMU integration, Sensor fusion, Camera and LiDAR interfacing.
* Environment: Linux / Ubuntu, Bash scripting, real robot hardware.

title: TECHNICAL WRITER
description:
**About Us:**




  





 Join a team that is redefining the accessibility of space. Azista space is a transformative force in the global aerospace sector, uniquely positioned at the intersection of indigenous innovation and industrial scalability. Operating India’s first private\-sector satellite mass\-production facility in Ahmedabad, we have bridged the gap between complex engineering and high\-volume manufacturing.
 



  





 As a vertically integrated leader, we provide end\-to\-end solutions from the precision design of satellite buses and advanced payloads to mission management and communication systems. We don’t just build hardware, we are democratizing the final frontier by providing global clientele with the cost\-effective, high\-performance technology needed to power the next generation of orbital missions. At Azista, you won't just be starting a job, you’ll be fuelling the future of space exploration.
 



  





  





**About the Role:**




  





 Azista Space is looking for a highly detail\-oriented Technical Writer – Aerospace \& Satellite Systems to support our next\-generation satellite development programs in Bengaluru. In this role, you will collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams across Avionics, AOCS, EPS, Structures, Propulsion, QA/PA, and Systems Engineering to create mission\-critical technical documentation that powers successful space missions.
 



  





 This is an exciting opportunity to work at the forefront of India’s private space ecosystem, contributing to high\-impact aerospace programs while shaping documentation frameworks aligned with ECSS, MIL\-STD, and defence\-grade engineering standards. If you are passionate about translating complex engineering concepts into precise, structured, and standards\-compliant technical content, this role offers exceptional exposure, growth, and industry impact.
 



  





  





**Roles \& Responsibilities:**




  




* Author and maintain high\-quality technical documentation including System Requirements Specifications (SRS), Interface Control Documents (ICDs), Design Descriptions, Test Procedures, User Manuals, and Qualification Reports
* Develop subsystem\-level documentation for EPS, Avionics/CDH, AOCS, Propulsion, RF/Comms, Structures, and Thermal Systems
* Create and manage technical review documentation for milestone reviews such as MDR, SRR, PDR, CDR, QR, and AR
* Collaborate closely with cross\-functional engineering teams to gather, validate, and structure technical information into clear, accurate deliverables
* Translate engineering inputs such as drawings, schematics, models, analyses, and test data into professional technical documents
* Ensure documentation compliance with ECSS standards (ECSS\-E\-ST, ECSS\-M\-ST, ECSS\-Q\-ST) and internal aerospace documentation frameworks
* Maintain document version control, revision histories, templates, numbering systems, and release workflows
* Coordinate document review cycles, consolidate reviewer feedback, and drive closure of action items and revisions
* Track and manage the Document Deliverables List (DDL) to ensure milestone adherence and programme readiness
* Support QA/PA documentation, including NCRs, qualification records, traceability matrices, and configuration audit documentation
* Conduct quality checks to ensure documentation accuracy, consistency, completeness, and technical integrity
* Interface with external vendors, partners, and stakeholders to align deliverable schedules and documentation standards



  





  





**Required Qualifications \& Skills:**




  




* Bachelor’s degree in aerospace engineering, Electronics, Mechanical Engineering, Technical Communication, or related disciplines
* 2–5 years of experience in technical writing within space, aerospace, defence, DRDO ecosystem, satellite systems, or engineering product development
* Proven expertise in writing and managing complex technical documentation such as ICDs, specifications, procedures, engineering reports, and test documentation
* Strong understanding of ECSS standards, MIL\-STD, DEF\-STAN, ISRO documentation practices, or equivalent aerospace documentation frameworks
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Word, including styles, templates, cross\-referencing, indexing, and revision tracking
* Experience with document management systems such as SharePoint or similar platforms
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings, block diagrams, schematics, test reports, and subsystem architectures
* Excellent written communication skills with a strong focus on technical accuracy, clarity, and structured documentation
* Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills across multidisciplinary engineering teams
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent deliverables in a fast\-paced, milestone\-driven aerospace environment



  





  





**Preferred Qualifications:**




  




* Experience documenting satellite subsystems including AOCS, EPS, Avionics/CDH, RF/Communications, Structures \& Thermal
* Exposure to AIT (Assembly, Integration \& Test) documentation such as ATP, ITP, and Test Reports
* Familiarity with requirements management tools like DOORS, Jama, or equivalent
* Experience supporting Functional Configuration Audits (FCA) and Physical Configuration Audits (PCA)
* Understanding of the complete space mission lifecycle and engineering review gates

**Position Overview**
 As a Technical Writer / Senior Technical Writer at LTSCT, you will be responsible for developing high\-quality product documentation that supports semiconductor hardware, software, and firmware solutions. This role requires the ability to understand complex technical concepts—spanning semiconductor technologies, associated subsystems, and software/firmware workflows—and translate them into clear, concise, user\-focused content.
   

  

 You will collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams including Engineering, Product Management, Quality, and globally distributed teams to gather information, structure documentation, and ensure consistency across deliverables. The ideal candidate demonstrates strong proficiency in structured authoring (DITA), single\-sourcing methodologies, and documentation lifecycle management using CCMS platforms. This role demands excellent communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in a fast\-paced environment while consistently meeting deadlines.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
* Create complete, high\-quality product documentation from the ground up, adhering to organizational standards and project timelines.
* Update documentation to reflect changes in product versions, features, specifications, and industry standards.
* Use structured authoring methodologies (e.g., DITA) to create reusable content modules.
* Maintain a single source of truth for documentation to support consistent outputs across multiple formats.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Product Management, and Quality teams to gather technical information and simplify complex concepts for diverse audiences.
* Review and edit documentation for grammar, accuracy, clarity, and technical correctness.
* Ensure compliance with industry standards such as IEEE, ISO, and JEDEC when documenting processes or specifications.
* Work effectively with both local and global teams across different time zones.
* Contribute to the development of standard diagrams, illustrations, videos, and presentations.
* Support special projects involving content review, proofreading, editing, and formatting for internal and external audiences.


**Qualifications \& Skills**
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering (preferably ECE, EEE, CSE), Technical Communication, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of experience as a Technical Writer, preferably in semiconductor hardware, software, and firmware documentation.
* Ability to design clear technical diagrams, architecture workflows, and visuals using Visio, Draw.io, or Adobe Illustrator.
* Experience using collaboration tools such as JIRA and Confluence.
* Exposure to documentation automation workflows (CI/CD publishing, Git branching, versioning pipelines, or scripted builds).
* Proven ability to manage documentation projects throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Strong experience with CCMS platforms and structured authoring methodologies to drive content reuse and maintain version control.


**Mandatory Skills**
* Proven expertise in DITA XML authoring and single\-sourcing practices.
* Proficiency in industry\-standard documentation tools such as Oxygen XML Editor or equivalent XML/DITA\-based editors.
* Experience collaborating directly with SMEs such as design engineers, firmware developers, and validation teams to extract technical information.
* Hands\-on experience working with product engineering teams, understanding development lifecycles, sprints, and review workflows.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to validate technical content against design specifications, datasheets, and release notes.
* Strong command of English writing, editing, and technical communication standards.


**Preferred Skills**
* Experience with CCMS\-based documentation tools, preferably Vasont Inspire.
* Experience writing and maintaining programming guides, user manuals, firmware guides, feature descriptions, and release documentation for semiconductors or SoC products.
* Experience documenting APIs, AT command sets, SDK workflows, or developer\-facing technical content.
* Familiarity with semiconductor terminology, chip architecture, block diagrams, and hardware development concepts.
* Knowledge of documentation automation, scripting, or Git\-based workflows.
* Ability to create multimedia content such as short videos, tutorials, or animations for product documentation.

description:

 Analyst with strong business fundamentals to join our Strategy team.  Joining this strategy role at Furlenco presents a multitude of compelling reasons that

Your strategic insights and recommendations will directly contribute to shaping Furlenco's competitive positioning, expansion plans, and overall success.
 



 2\. Holistic Perspective : This role involves working closely with cross\-functional teams and senior leadership, providing a broad view of the business landscape. This exposure allows you to gain insights into various aspects of the organization, from operations and marketing to finance and product development, fostering a holistic understanding of business dynamics.

You will be challenged to analyze market trends, assess competitive threats, and identify growth opportunities, keeping you engaged and motivated to expand your skill set.
 



  





 4\. Leadership Development : This role often involves leadership responsibilities, whether it's leading strategic initiatives, guiding project teams, or presenting recommendations to senior executives. This provides invaluable leadership development opportunities, helping you hone your decision\-making, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
 



  





 5\. High\-Level Exposure : Working in this strategy role offers exposure to high\-level discussions and decision\-making processes within the organization. You will have the chance to interact with C\-suite executives and other key stakeholders, gaining insights into strategic priorities and organizational goals.
 



  





 6\. Innovation and Creativity: This role requires innovative thinking and an creative problem\-solving to tackle complex challenges and capitalize on emerging opportunities. You will have the freedom to explore new ideas, develop innovative strategies, and drive initiatives that shape the future of the company.
 



  





 7\. Measurable Impact : One of the most rewarding aspects of this role is the ability to see the tangible impact of your work. Whether it's driving revenue growth, improving operational efficiency, or enhancing customer experience, your strategic initiatives will directly contribute to Furlenco's bottom line and long\-term success.
 



  





 Overall, joining this strategy role at Furlenco offers a unique opportunity to make a
 



 meaningful impact, gain valuable experience, and contribute to the continued growth
 



 and success of a dynamic and agile company.
 



  





**Job Description :** 




  




* Performance Analysis and Reporting: Track, analyze, amend, and report on key metrics related to customer retention, engagement, and revenue, and use insights to form strategic decisions and continuous improvement. Deep dive into data and present actionable insights.

* Financial Modelling : Understand business fundamentals and trends to draw revenue, churn and business health projections

* Customer Feedback and Insights: Gather and analyze customer feedback to identify pain points, opportunities for improvement, and trends, and advocate for customer\-centric initiatives. Leverages data from all aspects of the organization impacting churn (including NPS, customer satisfaction score and customer experience), etc.



  





**Experience :** 




  




* 1\+ years experience in a high impact analytical role delivering significant business results that utilize strategic and creative thinking, problem solving, and taking individual initiative preferably in the retail/ e\-commerce industry

**Meet the Team**
 The Cisco Wireless Platform team builds the foundational embedded software that powers Cisco’s wireless products. We work closely with hardware, system architecture, test, and product teams to bring up new platforms, enable core subsystems, and deliver reliable, high\-performance software at scale. Our work spans platform bring\-up, low\-level software development, system integration, and product readiness for enterprise wireless solutions.
   

  

**Your Impact**
 As a Platform Engineer, you will contribute to the development of embedded platform software for Cisco wireless products. You will work on low\-level software components, support hardware bring\-up and subsystem integration, and help debug and resolve system issues across the development lifecycle.
   

  

 We’re looking for engineers with strong embedded systems fundamentals, solid programming and debugging skills, and the ability to thrive in a highly collaborative environment. We also value candidates who are interested in modern AI\-enabled engineering practices and how AI\-assisted tools can improve engineering productivity, code quality, and execution speed.
   

  

 This role is based in Bengaluru, India.
   

  

 In This Role, You Will
   

  

* Contribute to the design, development, debugging, and validation of embedded software for


 wireless platform products.
   

  

* Support the development of low\-level platform software, including board support packages,


 platform services, boot\-time initialization, and device\-level components.
   

  

* Assist with hardware bring\-up and subsystem integration for new and existing platforms.
* Investigate software and system issues in embedded Linux environments, working closely with senior engineers to drive resolution.
* Contribute to software quality through code reviews, testing, automation, and continuous integration.
* Collaborate closely with hardware, test, manufacturing, and product engineering teams.
* Apply strong software engineering practices to deliver reliable, maintainable, and production\- ready platform software.


**Minimum Qualification**
* Have a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Have up to 1 year of experience in embedded software development through coursework, internships, or industry experience.
* Are proficient in C and C\+\+, with familiarity in Python or shell scripting.
* Have a strong understanding of embedded systems fundamentals, including memory, interrupts, concurrency, and hardware/software interfaces.
* Have a working knowledge of embedded Linux fundamentals.
* Have strong debugging, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.
* Have strong collaboration and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross\-functional teams and contribute in a highly collaborative engineering environment.
* Are interested in AI\-enabled engineering practices, including the use of AI\-assisted tools for software development, debugging, test automation, and productivity improvement.


**Preferred Qualification**
* Nice to have: exposure to board bring\-up, device drivers, or BSP development through academic projects or internships.
* Nice to have: familiarity with interfaces such as UART, SPI, I2C, GPIO, PCIe, or Ethernet.
* Nice to have: exposure to networking fundamentals or wireless technologies.

We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

title: Software Engineer
description:
**Meet the Team**
 The Cisco Wireless Platform team builds the foundational embedded software that powers Cisco’s wireless products. We work closely with hardware, system architecture, test, and product teams to bring up new platforms, enable core subsystems, and deliver reliable, high\-performance software at scale. Our work spans platform bring\-up, low\-level software development, system integration, and product readiness for enterprise wireless solutions.
   

  

**Your Impact**
 As a Platform Engineer, you will design, develop, and integrate embedded platform software for Cisco wireless products. You will own portions of low\-level platform software, drive subsystem integration, and troubleshoot system issues across development and productization. We’re looking for engineers who combine strong embedded Linux fundamentals with hands\-on debugging experience and the ability to work effectively across hardware and software boundaries. The ideal candidate is comfortable taking ownership, driving issues to closure, and using modern AI\-enabled engineering practices to improve productivity and execution
   

  

**Your Responsibilities In This Role**
* Design, develop, debug, and validate embedded software for wireless platform products.
* Own and enhance low\-level platform components, including board support packages, platform services, boot\-time initialization, and device\-level software.
* Drive hardware bring\-up and subsystem integration for new and existing platforms.
* Investigate complex software and system issues in embedded Linux environments and perform root\-cause analysis to deliver robust fixes.
* Contribute to performance, stability, and reliability improvements across the platform.
* Work closely with hardware, test, manufacturing, and product engineering teams to deliver production\-ready solutions.
* Contribute to code reviews, testing, automation, and continuous integration with a strong focus on software quality and maintainability.
* Use AI\-assisted development and debugging tools to improve engineering productivity, code quality, and development eﬀiciency.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s in Computer Science, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field with 5 Years of experience in embedded software development OR Master’s in Computer Science, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field with 3 Years of experience in embedded software development.
* Proficient in C and C\+\+, with working knowledge of Python or shell scripting.
* Experience with embedded Linux and low\-level platform software development.
* Very good understanding of embedded systems fundamentals, including memory, interrupts, concurrency, and hardware/software interfaces.
* Experience debugging software and system issues in embedded environments.
* Can work independently on well\-defined problems and collaborate effectively across cross\-functional teams.
* Comfortable in taking ownership of features or technical issues and driving them through resolution.
* Strong analytical, debugging, and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience or strong interest in AI\-enabled engineering practices, including the practical use of AI\-assisted tools for development, debugging, test automation, and productivity improvement.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with board bring\-up, device drivers, or BSP development.
* Familiarity with interfaces such as UART, SPI, I2C, GPIO, PCIe, or Ethernet.
* Exposure to networking fundamentals or wireless technologies.

* Development and delivery of high\-quality software solutions by using industry aligned programming languages, frameworks, and tools. Ensuring that code is scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance.

* Implementation of effective unit testing practices to ensure proper code design, readability, and reliability.


**Analyst Expectations**
* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in\-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub\-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Software Development Engineer 2 (Front-End)
description:
**About noon** 




 We’re building an ecosystem of digital products and services that power everyday life across the Middle East—fast, scalable, and deeply customer\-centric. Our mission is to deliver to every door every day. We want to redefine what technology can do in this region, and we’re looking for a Frontend Engineer level 2 (SDE2\) who can help us move even faster.
 



  





 noon’s mission: Every door, every day.
 



  





**What you'll do:** 




 Team noon has some of the fastest, smartest, and hardest\-working people we have encountered. With a young, aggressive, and talented team, we are driving major missions forward.
 



  





 We are looking for a Frontend Engineer level 2 (SDE2\) to join our Noon Food engineering team, working on mobile application and web platforms. You will build and scale high\-quality, user\-centric interfaces that support real\-time operations, ensuring smooth, responsive, and reliable experiences. A strong focus on craftsmanship, usability, and professional\-grade product quality is essential.
 



  




* Take ownership of features end\-to\-end, from development through to production release
* Develop and maintain scalable, reusable, and maintainable frontend components
* Build responsive interfaces that perform reliably across mobile and web platforms
* Contribute to delivering seamless and intuitive user experiences
* Apply strong proficiency in JavaScript and React.js to build high\-quality applications
* Utilize modern frontend tooling (e.g., Babel, Webpack, NPM) effectively in development workflows
* Identify opportunities for automation and implement solutions to improve team efficiency
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to deliver impactful product features



  





**What you’ll need:** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
* 3\+ years of experience building mobile\-first, consumer\-facing applications
* Strong proficiency in JavaScript (ES6\+) and React.js
* Solid understanding of HTTP, REST, and JSON\-based APIs
* Experience with Node.js / Express
* Strong focus on user experience, performance, and production quality
* Proven experience debugging and maintaining live, production systems at scale
* Knowledge of handling differences between iOS and Android, including UI design guidelines and performance optimization
* Strong skills in React Native
* Extensive knowledge of native mobile application development



  





**Who will excel?** 



* We’re looking for people with high standards, who understand that hard work matters.
* You need to be relentlessly resourceful and operate with a deep bias for action.
* We need people with the courage to be fiercely original.
* noon is not for everyone; readiness to adapt, pivot, and learn is essential.

Landing pages for paid campaigns, product feature pages, comparison pages (Illumine vs. Brightwheel, Illumine vs. Procare, you get it), pricing pages with interactive calculators, content hubs, microsites for events and webinars. Some weeks you'll ship five new pages. Some weeks you'll spend rebuilding one page three times because the conversion rate isn't where it should be.
* Managing the whole site. Performance, SEO hygiene, broken links, structured data, sitemap discipline, the lot. We've started thinking about AI search visibility (llms.txt, getting cited by ChatGPT and Perplexity, not just ranking in Google), and you'll own that work too.
* Connecting the plumbing. HubSpot forms, Factors.ai tracking, LinkedIn and Google audience pixels, our CRM. When marketing wants a new gated asset live by Friday, you make it happen without breaking attribution.
* Working with the brand. Our identity uses a pinwheel logo, a purple/teal/gold palette, and Lexend. You'll keep the site visually consistent while still letting individual campaigns feel fresh. We'd rather have a site that has a point of view than one that looks like every other B2B SaaS template.
* Iterating on what's working. A/B tests, heatmaps, scroll depth, conversion paths. You'll partner with Tanvi on marketing and pull from Factors and HubSpot data to figure out what's broken and fix it.



  





**What we're looking for** 



* Two\-plus years building real, shipped sites in Webflow. You should know CMS Collections cold, custom code embeds, interactions, the way the Designer actually behaves on a Tuesday afternoon when you're under deadline.
* Strong sense of design. You don't need to be the one creating brand systems from scratch, but you should be able to take a rough Figma file and ship something that looks tight, not janky.
* HTML, CSS, and JavaScript chops. Webflow gets you 90% of the way; the last 10% is where the magic and the bugs live.
* SEO instincts. Page speed, Core Web Vitals, schema markup, redirect maps when we migrate URLs. You don't wait for a marketer to tell you the meta description is missing.
* Comfort with marketing tools. HubSpot integrations, GA4, GTM, basic attribution thinking. Bonus if you've worked with Factors.ai or similar.
* A bias toward shipping. We move quickly. The site changes weekly. If you need three rounds of approvals before pushing anything live, this won't be a good fit.



  





**Bonus points** 



* You've worked in B2B SaaS before, ideally for a product that sells to non\-technical buyers (childcare directors, school owners, healthcare admins — that kind of audience).
* You've thought about AI search and how content gets surfaced inside ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, and Google AI Overviews. We're early on this and want someone who's curious.
* You've built or maintained a calculator, a quiz, or some other interactive element in Webflow that did real conversion work.

description:
**Job Description: Recruitment Executive at IND**

**Position Title:** Recruitment Executive  
**Location:** Sovabazar, Kolkata  
**Work Type:** Full\-time

**About the Role:**

As a Recruitment Executive at IND, based in Sovabazar, Kolkata, you will play a key role in sourcing, attracting, and hiring the best talent to meet the dynamic needs of the organization. Reporting directly to the Managing Director’s Office (MDO), your role will involve handling end\-to\-end recruitment, establishing strong external networks, and proactively engaging in diverse activities to ensure the success of recruitment initiatives. This position requires a hands\-on approach, including physically visiting and building relationships with various organizations, educational institutions, and networks for sourcing talent.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Talent Acquisition:**

* Manage the full recruitment lifecycle, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, selecting, and onboarding candidates.
* Explore and utilize diverse sourcing channels, including job portals, social media, referrals, campus recruitment, and in\-person networking, to attract top talent.
* Build and maintain relationships with colleges, universities, training institutes, and other organizations to create a robust talent pipeline.
* Visit external organizations, attend career fairs, and conduct outreach programs to expand the pool of prospective candidates.

**Candidate Evaluation and Engagement:**

* Conduct initial candidate screenings to assess qualifications, experience, and cultural fit.
* Coordinate interviews with hiring managers and department heads, ensuring seamless candidate communication.
* Maintain a positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment process.
* Support new hires during onboarding to ensure a smooth transition into the organization.

**Process Management and Strategy:**

* Work closely with the Managing Director’s Office to align recruitment efforts with organizational goals and priorities.
* Define and execute tri\-monthly, monthly, weekly, and daily recruitment objectives in collaboration with the MDO.
* Keep detailed records of recruitment metrics, including time\-to\-hire, quality of hires, and cost efficiency.
* Continuously improve recruitment processes to ensure efficiency and effectiveness.

**Networking and Outreach:**

* Actively engage with external organizations, colleges, and talent hubs to promote IND as an employer of choice.
* Establish partnerships with relevant organizations for sourcing candidates, including niche hiring needs.
* Represent IND at networking events, seminars, and job fairs to enhance the organization’s employer brand.

**Support for MDO and Diverse Activities:**

* Act as a point of coordination for recruitment\-related activities for the Managing Director’s Office.
* Be open to diverse and dynamic tasks beyond recruitment, as assigned by the MDO, to support organizational goals.
* Engage in activities that align with the strategic objectives of the organization, demonstrating flexibility and initiative.

**Key Skills and Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 1–3 years of experience in recruitment or talent acquisition, with a preference for candidates with experience in external networking and outreach.
* Excellent communication skills in Bengali, Hindi, and English (verbal and written).
* Strong interpersonal and negotiation skills to build relationships with external organizations and candidates.
* Proactive mindset with the ability to work independently and take ownership of tasks.
* Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.
* Comfortable with traveling locally and physically visiting organizations, colleges, and other institutions as part of recruitment efforts.
* Knowledge of recruitment tools and strategies, including job portals and social media platforms.

**Preferred Attributes:**

* Background in recruitment for educational, healthcare, or neurodevelopment\-focused organizations.
* Prior experience in campus hiring, networking, or relationship\-building with institutions.
* A growth\-oriented mindset with a willingness to learn and take on new challenges.
* Flexibility to engage in tasks beyond recruitment, as required by the Managing Director’s Office.

**Key Metrics for Success:**

* Quality of hires and their alignment with organizational goals.
* Time\-to\-hire for open positions and efficiency of the recruitment process.
* Effectiveness in building and maintaining external networks for sourcing.
* Success in achieving recruitment targets set by the Managing Director’s Office.
* Positive feedback from candidates and hiring managers regarding the recruitment process.

**Why Join IND?**

At IND, we are committed to creating meaningful change in the lives of children with Autism and other neurodevelopmental challenges. As a Recruitment Executive, you will play a critical role in building a team that supports our mission. This is an opportunity to engage in impactful work, grow professionally, and contribute to a transformative organization.
