title: Nursing Superintendent
description:
**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** 

Ø Work lawfully, co\-operatively and amicably with all the medical and other nursing staffs.

Ø Responsible for day to day patient care to the allocated patient.

Ø Responsible for Bed Making, Mouth Care, Sponging, Personal Hygiene, Back care/ Skin care of Allocated patient.

Ø Responsible for drug administration (Follow 6R Policy), Checking bed side stock medicines, Feeding (Oral/Ryle’s tube/ Parental).

Ø Proper Maintenance of case sheet.

Ø Responsible for assisting in Doctor’s round, Procedures, Investigation/OT preparation of allocated patient.

Ø Responsible for assisting \& helping with all the necessary information of the patient during doctor’s round of the allocated patient.

Ø Responsible for hand over and takeover of inventories and medicines of the allocated patient and ward.

Ø Responsible for helping in elimination of waste and to maintain Hospital Infection Control.

Ø Responsible for providing psychological support to the allocated patient and their relatives. All nursing staff will be wearing black shoe with proper uniform on duty.

Ø You have to join duty before 10 minutes of scheduled time. Handover should be taken post checking inventory, stock medicine, and consumables.

Ø Handover should be carried out in beside with medicine card and hand over register.

Ø Using personal mobile on duty hours is not allowed.

Ø Morning staff on duty will go for lunch only after handing over and evening duty staff will take hand over post lunch. Lunch after hand over is not allowed.

Ø Evening duty staff have to attend weekly classes of Dr. Talapatra, Mr.Koushik Hazra, Microbiologist and any Consultant’s classes. Any non\-adherence will be treated as absence from duty.

Ø GDA will take part in sponging, bed making, urine pot and giving bed pan,.

Ø 2 hourly back care have to given for ICCU patient.

Ø Don’t take leave without information of Technician.

Ø If any uncertain problem arises in Department then immediate inform to related technical person.

Ø Register of handover, stock medicine, inventory, pathology, radiology, blood transfusion must have to maintain.

Ø All staff must have to respect to senior, don’t make noise with senior.

Ø Non\-functional machines information must be pass on to Technician.

Ø In case of OT’s PAC ( Pre anesthetic checkup ) must be ensured in coordination with Floor Manager.

Ø Ensure all vital statistics checkup properly before writing in the note sheet for example urine out, Blood Pressure etc.

Ø In case of discharge extra medicine should be returned to pharmacy.

Ø Discharge medicine dosages must be discussed with patient party while patient gets discharged.

Ø For outside Diagnostics / Pathology tests floor manager must be informed and proper register to be maintained. Patient file should not accompany with the patient.

Ø To maintain TAT (Turn Around Time) in line with NABH proper register should be maintained in all wards.

Ø In case of emergency RMO must be connected through ward Cell phone and recording must be presented while enquiry.

Ø Dietary restrictions must be maintained in consultation with Dietician.

Ø Blood requisition should be rooted through Doctor. Proper protocol for Blood Transfusion must be followed at every step.

Ø During discharge Inter Venous channel and other external fixation must be removed from patient’s body.

Ø Medicines brand name and expiry date must be precisely checked before giving to the patients.

Ø Responsible for maintaining co\-ordination between patient/family and the Doctor.

Ø Responsible for performing in bedside physiotherapy/Breathing Exercise, Heamo Dynamic Monitoring \& Recording, Assisting major and minor dressings, Inhalation and nebulization, IV cannulation injection, IV therapy \& blood transfusion, ECG.

Ø Responsible for performing in CBS Checking/Suction, Charting/Recording and assessment chart filing, position changing and bedside care of the patient.

Ø Maintain stock of Emergency medicines with other inventories and sterile equipment checking for expiry date.

Ø Responsible for handling and maintaining crash cart trolley with the help of Sister Incharge.

Ø Check the crash cart trolley on the daily basis and also at the time of shift changing.

Ø Supervise Laundry stock.

Ø Cleaning and antiseptic Dressing, Maintaining aseptic technique and hand washing of allocated patient.

Ø Maintaining Admission, Transfer, Discharge, DOR, DORB procedure and patient file.

Ø Maintaining the entire check list \& nursing assessment documentation.

Ø Supervising good hygiene of ward and patient’s toilet.

Ø Proper maintaining of humidifier in central oxygen line.

Ø Instrument handling and maintaining (Monitors, Pulse Oxymeter, Syringe Pump, Infusion Pump, ECG machine, Defibrillator, Cardiac Monitor, Ventilator, Pulse generator, Holter monitor, CVP line etc.).

Ø Proper communication of all the sentinel events to the nursing administration.

Ø Participating in service classes regularly arranged by HR Department.

Ø Report to Sister In charge of the unit in related to any nursing care problem during work and must carry out her order to the best of your ability.

Ø Involvement in direct patient care along with admission, discharge, transfer in \& out and death protocols.

Ø Bridging gap between patient's party \& doctors.

Ø Assisting the MS/Visiting Consultant/Nursing Super/RMO/MO in their rounds.

Ø Supervision of all staff in completing clinical assessment chart of every patient including MOM.

Ø Report any unwanted incident to Sister In Charge/ Nursing Super

Ø Maintaining discipline and awareness of hospital policies \& protocols.

Ø Maintaining crash cart protocol.

Ø Maintaining disposal of biomedical waste.

Ø Responsible for helping QC team in collecting data and feedbacks.

Ø Responsible for cleanliness and ventilation of wards, service rooms and sanitary area as well as to the cleanliness of cupboards, floor, utensils etc.

Ø Responsible for all activity sheets and updating sheet for proper billing.

Ø Responsible for diet prescribing/changing /discharge/investigation/reports awaited/pre \& post operative procedures/PAC done/pending.

Ø Maintenance of Ward equipments \& biomedical equipments \& linen.

Ø Communicate with the Sister In Charge / Nursing Super in case of any infringement of misconduct committed by patient or their relatives.

Ø Responsible for maintaining Hospital Infection Control in collaboration with Sister in Charge/ Nursing Super and Infection Control committee.

Ø Exercise particular care in the event of discharge, transfer or death of patient.

Ø Responsible for special care for vulnerable patients.

Ø Responsible for end of life care procedure.

Ø Responsible for maintaining colour codes of patient.

Ø To perform all other duties as and when required for the better service of the hospital assigned by competent authority.

Ø The aforesaid work profile is illustrative in nature not exhaustive.

Reports / Records:

Records to be maintained are:

· Admission, transfer and discharge

· Stock Register of Medicine, Syringe.

· Stock Register of Linen of patient etc.

· Crash cart check list

· Register quality indicators.

· Event Register.

· Notifiable disease register.

· Handover register.

· Patient complaint book.

· Master equipment list.

· Equipment movement register.

· Equipment complaint book.

title: System Engineer
description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and analytical **Systems Engineer Intern / Fresher** to join our engineering infrastructure team. In this role, you will assist in building, maintaining, and troubleshooting our growing IT environments and systems. You will work closely with software developers and operations teams to ensure the highest levels of system availability, performance, and security. This is an ideal launchpad for an aspiring engineer eager to gain deep, hands\-on experience with server administration, networking, and automation.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **System Monitoring:** Assist in monitoring and supporting installed systems, servers, and infrastructure to ensure maximum availability and performance.
* **Installation \& Configuration:** Help install, configure, test, and maintain operating systems (primarily Linux/Unix and Windows), application software, and system management tools.
* **Troubleshooting:** Proactively diagnose, report, and resolve basic hardware, software, and network connectivity issues.
* **Task Automation:** Learn and write basic scripts (e.g., Python, Bash, or PowerShell) to automate routine operational tasks and reduce human intervention time.
* **Team Collaboration:** Work alongside developers and core engineering teams to identify system bottlenecks and support routine deployment cycles.
* **Technical Documentation:** Maintain clear, structured, and updated documentation for system configurations, deployment guides, and operational procedures.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* **Education:** B.Tech / B.E. / BCA / MCA in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline.
* **Core Concepts:** Solid foundational understanding of networking concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, OSI model, VPNs).
* **OS Knowledge:** Practical familiarity with Linux/Unix command lines or Windows Server administration.
* **Scripting (Preferred):** Basic knowledge of a scripting language like Python or Bash is a strong advantage.
* **Mindset:** Strong analytical and problem solving mindset, sharp attention to detail, and a deep willingness to learn new technologies quickly.
* **Communication:** Strong verbal and written communication skills to collaborate effectively in a fast\-paced environment.

**What We Offer**

* Direct mentorship from senior engineering leaders in an agile startup ecosystem.
* Hands\-on exposure to live production systems, cloud environments, and modern infrastructure practices.

* A clear pathway to full\-time career conversion based on performance during the internship.

* Assist in implementing trade schemes, promotional activities, and seasonal sales campaigns.

description:
**Job Title: Sales Manager**

**Role Overview:**  
The Sales Manager oversees all sales activities within the organization and is responsible for developing and implementing sales strategies to drive growth and meet or exceed sales targets. This role involves managing and motivating a team of sales professionals, analyzing sales data, identifying market trends, and building strong relationships with clients.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Sales Strategy Development:** Develop comprehensive sales strategies aligned with company objectives to maximize revenue generation and market penetration.
* **Team Leadership:** Lead, mentor, and motivate the sales team to achieve individual and collective sales targets. Provide coaching and support to enhance team performance.
* **Client Relationship Management:** Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with key clients, understanding their needs and preferences to provide tailored solutions and enhance customer satisfaction.
* **Sales Performance Analysis:** Analyze sales data, market trends, and competitor activities to identify areas for improvement and develop actionable insights to optimize sales performance.
* **Forecasting and Budgeting:** Prepare sales forecasts and budgets based on market analysis and business objectives. Monitor performance against targets and take corrective actions as needed.
* **Sales Process Optimization:** Continuously refine and improve sales processes to enhance efficiency and effectiveness. Implement best practices and leverage technology to streamline workflows.
* **Collaboration:** Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including marketing, product development, and customer service, to ensure alignment of sales strategies with overall business goals.
* **Reporting:** Generate regular sales reports and present findings to senior management, providing updates on sales performance, market trends, and opportunities for growth.

**Skills and Qualifications:**

* Proven track record of success in sales, with experience in sales management preferred.
* Strong leadership and motivational skills, with the ability to inspire and coach a diverse team.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build rapport and negotiate effectively.
* Analytical mindset, with the ability to interpret sales data and market trends to drive informed decisions.
* Strategic thinking and problem\-solving abilities, with a focus on driving results and exceeding targets.
* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, marketing, or a related field (MBA is a plus).
* Proficiency in CRM software and Microsoft Office Suite.

**Working Conditions:**

* The Sales Manager typically works in an office environment but may also spend time meeting with clients and attending industry events.
* This role may require occasional travel to meet with clients or attend conferences.

**Salary Range:**  
The salary for a Sales Manager varies depending on factors such as experience, industry, location, and company size. On average, the salary range for a Sales Manager is $60,000 to $150,000 per year, with additional bonuses and commissions based on performance.

**Conclusion:**  
A Sales Manager plays a critical role in driving revenue growth and maximizing profitability for an organization. By leading a high\-performing sales team and implementing effective sales strategies, the Sales Manager contributes to the overall success and competitiveness of the business.

description:
Who We Are


Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.  

  

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

  

What You'll Do


You will work at the core of BCG’s global Talent Acquisition ecosystem, connecting policies, tools, and processes to strengthen governance, reduce risk, and ensure compliant operations worldwide. Your main responsibilities will include:

 **Policy Governance and Compliance**

* Own and continuously evolve global Talent Acquisition policies and governance frameworks to enable compliant, risk\-mitigated operations with a strong focus on data privacy and protection
* Drive alignment across Legal, the Data Protection Office (DPO), Responsible AI (RAI), and other stakeholders to translate regulatory requirements into scalable operational practices
* Lead the development and deployment of GenAI\-enabled solutions that improve policy accessibility, accelerate updates, and strengthen adoption and adherence globally
* Identify policy gaps, compliance risks, and operational trends, providing actionable recommendations to improve governance effectiveness and reduce risk exposure

 **Tool Access Management and Coordination**

* Own user access governance for core TA platforms, including operational oversight, access structures, role models, and continuous optimization of UAM processes
* Drive harmonized access management practices across regions and business units to improve consistency, transparency, and operational efficiency
* Analyze platform usage patterns, access trends, and user behaviors to generate actionable insights and recommend improvements to platform governance and user experience
* Lead and grow a global user community that promotes knowledge sharing, adoption, and scalable best practices across recruiting teams

 **Process Harmonization and Insights**

* Lead the analysis and harmonization of recruiting processes across local, regional, and business unit teams to identify root causes, eliminate inefficiencies, and define scalable best practices
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives by translating operational findings and stakeholder feedback into practical, high\-impact recommendations
* Own KPI frameworks and reporting approaches that generate meaningful insights into policy effectiveness, operational performance, and process improvement opportunities
* Drive stakeholder alignment through structured governance forums, clear decision documentation, and end\-to\-end ownership of follow\-up actions and implementation tracking

 **CoE Positioning and Impact**

* Strengthen the GTA OPS Center of Excellence (CoE) as a trusted global authority for recruiting operations, governance, and process excellence
* Lead the GTA OPS Functional Leadership Community (FLC), driving collaboration, alignment, and exchange of scalable operational best practices across teams
* Partner with Talent Acquisition Learning \& Development to design and deliver practical, up\-to\-date learning solutions that improve adoption of global policies, tools, and processes

  

What You'll Bring

* 4\+ years of experience in Talent Acquisition, HR operations, governance, or a related field
* Proven ability to drive operational improvements, manage cross\-functional initiatives, and deliver results in global, matrixed environments
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities, including experience translating data and operational insights into practical recommendations
* Experience working across global stakeholders and navigating complex organizational environments with clarity and sound judgment
* Strong digital fluency, including Microsoft 365, reporting tools, and GenAI\-enabled applications
* Practical understanding of data privacy, compliance, and risk considerations related to HR or recruiting operations
* Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands\-on execution in a fast\-paced, evolving environment


Please note this position is not restricted solely to the responsibilities listed above and that the job scope and responsibilities are subject to change

  

Who You'll Work With

* You will be part of BCG's Global Talent Acquisition team, reporting to the Senior Manager and Head of BCG’s Global TA OPS CoE
* You will collaborate with global stakeholders across Process, Product, Data, IT, Finance, Procurement, and Legal
* The working environment reflects the best of BCG: collaborative, trust\-based, dynamic, and strongly outcome\-oriented

  

Additional info

**You are good at**

* Taking ownership of complex operational topics and independently driving initiatives from problem identification through implementation
* Applying structured problem\-solving and critical thinking to identify root causes, generate insights, and recommend scalable improvements
* Influencing and aligning stakeholders across global, cross\-functional environments through clear and persuasive communication
* Translating data, operational trends, and user feedback into actionable recommendations and measurable process improvements
* Leveraging technology, automation, and GenAI solutions to improve operational effectiveness and user experience
* Managing sensitive and confidential information with integrity, sound judgment, and strong risk awareness

description:
**About The Team**
 Our HR team operates as a strategic partner to the business, focused on cultivating a high\-performance culture where exceptional talent thrives. Our work is fundamentally guided by the DICE (Democratize Internet Commerce for Everyone) mission, which underpins our approach to all people strategies. Our core mandate centers on two critical pillars: driving world\-class Talent Density and continuously elevating Employee Experience. We achieve this by relentlessly attracting, developing, and retaining the highest caliber of professionals, ensuring that every individual contributes significantly to our success. Concurrently, we are committed to shaping an unparalleled employee experience—one defined by transparent communication, meaningful development, and a deeply engaging, inclusive culture. As stewards of the company's most valuable asset—its people—we design, implement, and champion people strategies that directly translate into sustained business growth and a position as one of India’s most sought\-after e\-commerce destinations.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a seasoned HR Business Partner to lead \& manage the 3P / Contract Workforce across multiple Teams and locations. This role will act as the primary HRBP for all third\-party employees, driving workforce governance, employee relations, compliance, \& productivity in close partnership with Operations. The incumbent will manage a team of 4 HRBPs and work closely with Staffing Partners, TA, HR Ops, Legal, and Business managers to ensure seamless lifecycle management, strong compliance discipline, and a high\-performance field workforce. This is a highly field\-intensive role requiring strong stakeholder management, ER expertise, data\-driven decision\-making, \& the ability to handle escalations with maturity \& speed.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Workforce Planning \& Hiring
* Partner with Business Manager and Biz finance teams on manpower planning \& workforce budgeting.
* Maintain visibility on headcount status, vacancies, redeployments, \& attrition trends across Teams.
* Coordinate with staffing vendors and TA to support hiring for 3P roles \& ensure timely fulfillment.
* Onboarding \& Documentation
* Oversee onboarding processes including documentation, BGV, contract issuance, \& HRMS updates.
* Ensure statutory compliance, minimum wages adherence, \& labour law norms during employee onboarding.
* Coordinate contract renewals and maintain complete lifecycle documentation.
* Attendance, Payroll \& Workforce Governance
* Validate payroll inputs, leave records, and attendance data in partnership with vendors \& HR Ops.
* Conduct regular audits to ensure compliance, documentation accuracy, \& audit readiness.
* Track productivity, attendance discipline, and overall workforce hygiene across Teams.
* Employee Experience \& Engagement
* Conduct regular employee connects, field visits, \& skip\-level meetings to proactively identify concerns.
* Standardize employee communication and drive awareness of policies and code of conduct.
* Implement structured grievance redressal mechanisms and ensure timely closure of employee concerns.
* Drive performance management processes for 3P employees in collaboration with Business teams
* Employee Relations \& Compliance
* Manage ER cases related to misconduct, fraud, absenteeism, performance issues,
* and policy violations.
* Conduct investigations, maintain documentation, and recommend appropriate
* disciplinary actions.

title: Senior Human Resources Manager
description:
**About Thinkthrough Consulting** 




 Thinkthrough Consulting (TTC) is a purpose\-led, multidisciplinary professional services firm specialising in advisory support for sustainable development. TTC engages clients across sectors to address critical development challenges – bringing together the best available expertise and solutions to drive efficiency and impact.
 



 TTC emphasises a tri\-sector approach, facilitating synergy between government, corporate, and civil society for holistic, sustainable development. Our solutions are aligned with the SDGs (the ‘Global Goals’) and are tailored to the specific needs of clients across diverse sectors.
 



 TTC operates as a commercial consulting firm. Engagements are fee\-based and professionally structured; the people function is expected to reflect the pace, standards, and commercial awareness of a professional services environment.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 The Senior Manager – HR will own the people agenda for TTC, aligning HR strategy with the firm’s business objectives and growth trajectory. This is not a back\-office HR role – it requires someone who understands how a consulting firm operates commercially, can engage credibly with Partners and practice leads, and can build the people infrastructure that a scaling professional services organisation needs.
 



 The role spans the full breadth of HR: talent acquisition, performance management, organisational development, compensation, compliance, and culture. The successful candidate will bring both strategic thinking and a willingness to be hands\-on – at a firm of TTC’s size, the HR leader must operate comfortably across both levels.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. HR Strategy \& Organisational Development** 




 •    Partner with the leadership team to shape and implement the HR strategy aligned with TTC’s business plan and growth priorities
 



 •    Drive organisational development initiatives – including team structuring, role clarity, leadership development, and culture building
 



 •    Advise Partners on people\-related dimensions of business decisions: project staffing, team composition, capacity planning
 



 •    Define and embed TTC’s employer value proposition to support talent attraction and retention
 



**2\. Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning** 




 •    Lead recruitment across consulting, technical, and support roles – ensuring quality of hire, speed, and alignment with TTC’s positioning
 



 •    Build and manage sourcing channels: campus partnerships, referral programmes, specialist recruiters, and lateral hiring pipelines
 



 •    Own workforce planning in coordination with engagement leads – anticipating demand based on project pipeline and utilisation data
 



**3\. Performance Management \& Talent Development** 




 •    Design and run the performance management cycle: goal\-setting, mid\-year check\-ins, annual reviews, calibration, and outcome communication
 



 •    Build structured learning and development interventions – onboarding programmes, consulting skills training, leadership tracks
 



 •    Identify and nurture high\-potential talent; develop succession planning frameworks for critical roles
 



 •    Strengthen employee engagement and retention strategies grounded in data, not assumptions
 



**4\. Compensation, Benefits \& Compliance** 




 •    Manage compensation structures, benchmarking, and annual salary review processes; ensure internal equity and market alignment
 



 •    Oversee benefits administration and total rewards positioning
 



 •    Ensure full compliance with applicable labour laws, statutory requirements (PF, ESI, Gratuity, PT), and internal policies
 



 •    Lead POSH implementation and maintain a safe, respectful workplace environment
 



 •    Maintain HR documentation and audit readiness at all times
 



**5\. Employee Relations \& Culture** 




 •    Act as a trusted advisor to employees and leadership on people matters – with sensitivity, fairness, and confidentiality
 



 •    Handle grievances and employee concerns; manage conflict resolution with maturity
 



 •    Foster a culture of openness, accountability, and professional respect – appropriate for a consulting firm that works with institutional clients
 



**6\. Team Leadership** 




 •    Lead and develop the HR team; build capability in HR business partnering, operations, and organisational development
 



 •    Drive a culture of process rigour, data discipline, and continuous improvement within the function
 



 •    Serve as the HR interface for Partners and practice leads – translating business needs into people actions
 



  





**Education \& Experience** 




 •    MBA / PGDM in Human Resources or related field from a reputed institution
 



 •    10–15 years of progressive HR experience, with at least 5–7 years in an HR leadership role
 



 •    Prior experience in consulting, professional services, or knowledge\-driven organisations strongly preferred
 



 •    Demonstrated experience in organisational development, talent management, and strategic HR – not just HR operations
 



  





**Skills \& Competencies** 




 •    Strong grasp of HR frameworks, talent management, and organisational design
 



 •    High emotional intelligence; able to navigate sensitive conversations and build trust across levels
 



 •    Analytical mindset – comfortable using HR data and metrics to inform decisions, not just intuition
 



 •    Excellent written and verbal communication; able to present to leadership with clarity and confidence
 



 •    Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands\-on execution in a lean team environment
 



  





**What We’re Looking For** 




 •    Someone who understands that HR in a consulting firm is a business function, not an administrative one
 



 •    Comfort operating in a commercial environment – TTC serves development sector clients but runs as a for\-profit professional services firm
 



 •    High integrity, discretion, and professionalism in handling sensitive organisational and people matters
 



 •    Genuine interest in building institutions – not just filling seats
 



 •    Ownership mindset – you treat TTC’s people outcomes as your personal accountability

At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high\-quality medicines worldwide.
   

  

 At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
   

  

 USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit\-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
   

  

**Brief Job Overview**
 Senior Talent Acquisition Partner is a key mission enabler at USP and we’re seeking an exceptional recruiter to join our team. Our new team member will lead their hiring managers through the full lifecycle of recruiting for a variety of professional, technical, scientific, and administrative positions. Primary responsibilities involve deep partnership and with business leaders and hiring managers to effectively source, recruit, evaluate, interview, and select top Acquisition/HR projects that will strengthen USP offerings and branding as an employer of choice.
   

  

**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**
 As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high\-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence\-based decision\-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.
   

  

 Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high\-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results\-driven work environments.
   

  

**The Sr. TA Partner Has The Following Responsibilities**
* Conducts full lifecycle recruiting for assigned searches beginning with a strategy meeting with the hiring manager to discuss process and strategic sourcing approach
* Creates an effective sourcing strategy based on business needs and identify candidates through standard and creative methods
* Evaluates the resumes/profiles of prospective candidates and determines degree of skill match; recommends or declines appropriately and forwards qualified short\-listed candidate resumes to the hiring manager for review.

* Support in designing and executing employer branding initiatives to position the organization as an employer of choice, leveraging digital platforms and recruitment marketing tools.

 The Successful Candidate Will Have a Demonstrated Understanding Of Our Mission, Commitment To Excellence Through Inclusive And Equitable Behaviors And Practices, Ability To Quickly Build Credibility With Stakeholders, Along With The Following Competencies And Experience
   

  

* Master's Degree/Post Graduate Diploma (Full\-Time) in Human Resource Management from a business school is preferred, with 10 years of professional recruiting experience to include leadership and strategic project experience.
* Demonstrated full\-lifecycle recruitment experience working in corporate or agency environments.
* Experience in cold calling, candidate development and directly sourcing candidates from a variety of media including standard sourcing tools (social networks, corporate websites, general job boards, professional associations, agencies, college postings and alumni organizations, open houses) to build candidate pipelines

description:
**About Us**
 Notion helps you build beautiful tools for your life’s work. In today's world of endless apps and tabs, Notion provides one place for teams to get everything done, seamlessly connecting docs, notes, projects, calendar, and email—with AI built in to find answers and automate work. Millions of users, from individuals to large organizations like Toyota, Figma, and OpenAI, love Notion for its flexibility and choose it because it helps them save time and money.
   

  

 In\-person collaboration is essential to Notion's culture. We require all team members to work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays, our designated Anchor Days. Certain teams or positions may require additional in\-office workdays
   

  

**About The Role**
 Millions of people use Notion — and this number is increasing every day. That means millions of people trust us to deliver a fast, reliable, and secure experience, and we value this more than anything. We want to keep earning trust, while also continuing to amaze our users with the tools they can build in Notion. The Developer Experience team is responsible for architecting, implementing, and scaling the tools and frameworks that Notion developers use to build Notion. We are looking for engineers who are passionate about solving engineering productivity challenges, have deep empathy for other developers, and love to communicate with engineers. You don't need to have experience in this domain but willing to advocate for developer experience is the key.
   

  

**What You'll Achieve**
* Collaborate with engineers across the company to deliver an industry\-leading developer experience, along the way working deeply with tools like the TypeScript language server, lint tooling, and the Notion CLI to improve developers’ day to day experience.
* Work on the bleeding edge of tooling performance, researching and evaluating new tools and keeping up with new developments in the developer experience space in the JS ecosystem.
* Work deeply with GitHub and our CI systems to help ensure engineers can merge their code quickly and safely. We aim for all PR CI pipelines to finish within 15 minutes!
* Take ownership of our development environment and toolchain, and contribute to novel projects across the company to deliver impact.


**Skills You'll Need To Bring**
* Over 8 years of hands\-on software development experience, thriving in fast\-paced and dynamic environments.
* A drive to make developers’ lives better: you have a strong interest in keeping engineers in their flow state through better tooling. You like to think critically about the workflows engineers use in their day to day work, finding bottlenecks and thinking outside of the box to find ways to pave a better golden path for engineers to follow.
* A focus on user experience: you bring care and craft to the user experience you build into your products. Your work emphasizes simplicity, supportability, and ease\-of\-use, and you communicate clearly with other teams and engineers to get feedback on where we can improve.
* Multitasker and present: you like interrupts especially if this is blocking engineers. You switch between your project work and day to day developer experience challenges.
* Interest in learning how things work: you love to learn how the tools you use work at a fundamental level. You get excited at the idea of digging into third\-party source code to understand how they work and find new ways to use them.
* Pragmatic and business\-oriented: You care about business impact and prioritize projects accordingly. You don't just go after cool stuff—you understand the balance between craft, speed, and the bottom line. To you, technologies and programming languages are about tradeoffs. You may be opinionated, but you're not ideological and can learn new technologies as you go.
* You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.


**Nice To Haves**
* Familiarity with TypeScript, especially in ways to keep it running smoothly in a large codebase.
* An interest in automated testing and familiarity with testing best practices.
* Past experience with React and common tooling like React Testing Library.
* Past experience on developer experience teams or related tools.


 We hire talented and passionate people from a variety of backgrounds because we want our global employee base to represent the wide diversity of our customers. If you’re excited about a role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every bullet point listed in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. If you’re a builder at heart, share our company values, and enthusiastic about making software toolmaking ubiquitous, we want to hear from you.
   

  

 Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. title: Recruitment & Training Coordinator
description:
Role Summary

The Recruitment \& Training Coordinator will be responsible for supporting manpower planning, recruitment, onboarding, employee training, and skill development across Unimech’s foundry, machine shop, quality, maintenance, stores, and office functions. The role will ensure that the right people are hired, properly inducted, trained for their responsibilities, and continuously developed to meet Unimech’s operational and growth requirements.

Key Roles \& Responsibilities

1\. Recruitment Coordination

* Coordinate with department heads to understand manpower requirements.
* Prepare and publish job postings on platforms such as Indeed, LinkedIn, WhatsApp groups, local agencies, and recruitment portals.
* Screen resumes and shortlist suitable candidates.
* Schedule interviews with department heads and management.
* Maintain a recruitment tracker with candidate status, feedback, joining dates, and salary expectations.
* Coordinate with contractors and agencies for labour requirements, especially for foundry operations.
* Support hiring for operators, helpers, technicians, inspectors, office staff, and junior management roles.

2\. Interview \& Selection Support

* Conduct initial screening calls with candidates.
* Verify basic experience, salary expectations, notice period, location preference, and willingness to work in a manufacturing environment.
* Arrange trade tests or practical evaluations where required.
* Collect interview feedback from technical teams.
* Support offer discussions and joining coordination.

3\. Onboarding \& Joining Formalities

* Ensure new employees complete joining documents, ID proof, bank details, photographs, and statutory forms.
* Coordinate induction for new joiners.
* Explain company rules, attendance requirements, leave procedure, safety expectations, and reporting structure.
* Ensure new employees are introduced to their department head and team.
* Maintain employee records in physical and digital formats.

4\. Training Coordination

* Identify training needs in discussion with department heads.
* Prepare and maintain a training calendar for workers, staff, supervisors, and new joiners.
* Coordinate internal training sessions on safety, quality, process discipline, ERP usage, inspection practices, and workplace behaviour.
* Track training attendance and effectiveness.
* Maintain training records for audits and customer requirements.
* Follow up with employees and supervisors to ensure training learnings are implemented on the shop floor.

5\. Skill Matrix \& Competency Development

* Maintain department\-wise skill matrices for foundry, machining, NDT, inspection, stores, maintenance, and office teams.
* Track employee skill levels and identify gaps.
* Coordinate cross\-training and upskilling plans.
* Support development of multi\-skilled employees to improve flexibility in production.
* Monitor progress of trainees, helpers, and junior staff.

6\. Compliance \& Documentation

* Maintain recruitment files, interview records, appointment letters, training records, and employee documents.
* Support HR documentation required for audits, customer visits, and statutory compliance.
* Ensure training records are properly filed and retrievable.
* Assist in maintaining records related to safety training, quality training, and process training.

7\. Employee Communication \& Follow\-Up

* Act as a coordinator between HR, management, department heads, employees, and labour contractors.
* Follow up with new employees during the initial joining period.
* Escalate attendance, behaviour, or performance concerns to HR/management.
* Support communication of company policies, discipline requirements, and training initiatives.

Required Skills \& Competencies

* Good communication skills in English, Malayalam and Tamil; Hindi will be an added advantage.
* Ability to speak confidently with candidates, workers, supervisors, and managers.
* Basic understanding of manufacturing recruitment.
* Strong follow\-up and coordination skills.
* Good record\-keeping and documentation ability.
* Working knowledge of MS Excel, Google Sheets, email, and job portals.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality.
* Practical, disciplined, and shop\-floor oriented approach.

Preferred Experience

* 1–4 years of experience in HR, recruitment, training coordination, or manpower coordination.
* Experience in a manufacturing, foundry, machining, engineering, or industrial environment preferred.
* Fresh HR graduates may also be considered if they are strong in communication and follow\-up.

Key Performance Indicators

* Time taken to close open positions.
* Quality and retention of new hires.
* Completion of joining formalities on time.
* Training calendar adherence.
* Training attendance and documentation accuracy.
* Skill matrix updates and closure of identified skill gaps.
* Support provided to departments for manpower availability.

description:
Good with people and thinking creatively?  
 




**If yes, then you need to read this.** 




  





**Integra Magna is hiring an HR \& Marketing Intern.** 




  






 You’ll help us find and hire great people, create smoother employee experiences, and support marketing campaigns that make our brand stand out online and offline.
 




  






 If you enjoy working with people, love creative ideas, and want a role that blends HR with marketing, keep reading.

* Support recruitment by sourcing candidates, screening resumes, coordinating interviews, and maintaining hiring records.

 We’re looking for someone adaptable and open to supporting related team requirements and responsibilities as needed.

 Music playing in the background, coffee brewing in the studio, and people casually turning random thoughts into real ideas.

*At Sun Life, we empower you to be your most brilliant self.*

* **Investments.** Mutual funds, segregated funds, annuities, and guaranteed investment products
* **Advice.** Financial planning and retirement planning services
* **Asset management.** Pooled funds, institutional portfolios, and pension funds

With innovative technology, a strong distribution network and long\-standing relationships with some of the world’s largest employers, we are today providing financial security to millions of people globally.


Sun Life is a leading financial services company that helps our clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives, with strong insurance, asset management, investments, and financial advice portfolios. At Sun Life, our asset management business draws on the talent and experience of professionals from around the globe.


**SLGS(Sun Life Global Solutions)** provides Technology and Business Solutions to Sun Life businesses globally. Started in 2006, since then SLGS has achieved scale, growth, and operational maturity. Asia Service Centres today has more than 1100 Engineers, 200\+ AWS professionals, and a group of Certified Actuaries. They deliver various complex business solutions. We want to create an environment where you feel empowered to take action and are surrounded by people who challenge you, support you and inspire you to become the best version of yourself. description:
**Position:** MSW Officer

**Location**: Baramati, Tal \- Baramati, Dist \- Pune

**Department:** Labour Welfare / Human Resources

**Employment Type:** Full\-time

**Job Summary:**

The Welfare Officer is responsible for ensuring the well\-being and welfare of sugarcane harvesting labourers employed by the sugar factory. This role includes overseeing living and working conditions, addressing grievances, facilitating access to essential services. The Welfare Officer acts as a bridge between the workers and management to promote a healthy, safe, and productive work environment.

**Key Responsibilities:** 

**1\. Human Rights Due Diligence (HRDD):** 

\- Conduct HRDD assessments in coordination with mill management, identifying and mitigating risks to workers’ rights.

\- Develop and implement strategies to address workplace human rights issues, with particular focus on women’s welfare and gender equity.

\- Provide training on human rights principles, including prevention of harassment, gender sensitivity, and anti\-discrimination practices.

\- Collaborate with the sustainability manager of client companies to meet HRDD standards and ensure transparent communication.

\- Grievance Mechanisms: Support the development and monitoring of safe, anonymous grievance redressal mechanisms.

**2\. Occupational Health and Safety (OHS):** 

**\-** Develop, implement, and enforce OHS policies and practices at the workplace.

\- Conduct safety audits, risk assessments, and site inspections to identify and resolve hazards.

\- Organize training programs to promote a culture of safety, focusing on vulnerable groups, including women and seasonal workers.

\- Investigate and document workplace accidents, ensuring that corrective and preventive actions are in place.

**3\. Fair Working Conditions and Women’s Welfare:** 

**\-** Ensure compliance with fair wages, reasonable working hours, and equitable treatment of all workers.
